samples.title: Corridor walk-through (hard hats and vests)
samples.description: A 65-second fixed-camera clip of people walking along an indoor corridor towards the camera, singly and in groups of up to three.
samples.scenarios: Some people wear a yellow hard hat and an orange safety vest. At least two people wear dark clothing without a vest (one of them with a hard hat, one apparently without). Nothing was staged or edited by us and nothing was added to the video; the assessment labels are produced by the pipeline, not by hand.
samples.attribution: © 2021 Intel Corporation. Footage Safety_Full_Hat_and_Vest.mp4 from intel-iot-devkit/safety-gear-detector-python, downscaled to 960×540 and re-encoded as MP4 (H.264) and WebM (VP8), audio removed.
samples.note: We rely on the repository's BSD-3-Clause licence for this footage; Intel does not state the footage's own provenance separately. No ground truth is published for it.
